Specification of Cryptography
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
1 Introduction and functional overview
This specification describes the functionality and the configuration for the Adaptive
AUTOSAR
Functional Cluster
Cryptography (
FC Crypto
) and its API (
Cryp-
toAPI
, which is part of the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform Foundation.
The
FC Crypto
offers applications and other Adaptive AUTOSAR
Functional
Clusters
a standardized interface, which provides operations for cryptographic and
related calculations. These operations include cryptographic operations, key manage-
ment, and certificate handling.
FC Crypto
manages the actual implementations of
all operations, the configuration, and the brokering of operations from applications to
implementations. The standardized interface is exposed by the
CryptoAPI
.
The
FC Crypto
and its
CryptoAPI
supports both public-key and symmetric-key cryp-
tography. It allows applications to use mechanisms such as authentication, encryption,
and decryption for automotive services.
